online_dependencies: Labs intentionally read the public events Parquet dataset from S3 using TVF, INSERT SELECT and object storage queries.
Lab 3 downloads its small CSV and JSONL fixtures from the public dataset bucket when taught; the image contains no loaded tables.
The course's Doris startup explicitly runs docker pull for its fixed tag, so Docker Hub manifest/auth endpoints remain required even when image layers are cached.
SSM and activity administration require AWS endpoints. The first image build requires Ubuntu/Docker APT and PyPI.
Optional Metabase and all other profiles, external models and model keys are excluded. No custom container build or plugin is required by rta-main.
